defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Uses essentially exhaustive 3^n-style backtracking and does not provide a sufficiently strong worst-case pruning strategy for n=40, causing TLE.
Uses greedy BFS coloring and assumes locally assigning an available color is sufficient; greedy coloring can reject or mishandle graphs that are nevertheless 3-colorable.
